$schema_note: Generated from MudManager::Mcp::ToolSpec, which reads MudManager::Primitives enum constants at call time. Ruby is canonical; do not hand-edit this file.

tools.name: look
tools.description: Look at the current room or at a specific target. Call with NO arguments to describe the current room (do NOT pass target: 'room'). Pass a target to inspect a specific item, mob, or player. Use preposition 'in' to look inside a container, 'at' to inspect something, or a direction to peek into an adjacent room.

target.description: Item, mob, or player to inspect. Omit entirely to describe the current room.

tools.name: examine
tools.description: Examine a target in detail (more verbose than look).

target.description: The item, mob, or player to examine

tools.name: check
tools.description: Query information about your character or surroundings.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move one step in a compass direction, or up/down.

tools.name: flee
tools.description: Attempt to flee from combat in a random available direction.

tools.name: set_position
tools.description: Change body position. Use 'rest' or 'sleep' between fights to recover HP and mana. You must be standing to move or fight.

tools.name: track
tools.description: Attempt to track a mob or player by name, revealing which direction they are in. Requires the Track skill.

target.description: Name of the mob or player to track

tools.name: attack
tools.description: Attack a target. Style 'kill' is the standard approach; 'murder' bypasses the mercy check; 'hit' is a one-off strike.

target.description: Name of the mob or player to attack

tools.name: skill_strike
tools.description: Use a combat skill against a target.

target.description: Name of the mob or player

tools.name: consider
tools.description: Assess a mob's relative strength before engaging. Returns a phrase such as 'You could kill it easily' or 'Death awaits you'. Always consider before attacking an unknown mob.

target.description: Name of the mob to consider

tools.name: say
tools.description: Speak or emote in the current room.

tools.name: tell
tools.description: Send a private message to a specific player.

tools.name: channel_say
tools.description: Broadcast a message over a global channel.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Pick up an item from the room or from a container.

item.description: Name of the item to get

tools.name: drop_item
tools.description: Drop, donate, or junk an item.

tools.name: put_item
tools.description: Put an item into a container.

item.description: Name of the item to put

tools.name: equip_item
tools.description: Wear, wield, hold, grab, or remove an item.

body_loc.description: Body location to wear it on, e.g. 'head', 'finger'

tools.name: consume_item
tools.description: Eat, drink, taste, or sip a consumable item.

item.description: Name of the item to consume

tools.name: cast_spell
tools.description: Cast a spell, optionally at a target. Use the full spell name, e.g. 'cure light wounds' or 'magic missile'.

tools.name: use_magic_item
tools.description: Activate a magic item: quaff a potion, recite a scroll, or use a wand/staff.

item.description: Name of the item to activate

target_args.description: Optional target arguments, e.g. a mob name for a wand

tools.name: shop
tools.description: Interact with a shop NPC: list stock, buy, sell, or value an item.

tools.name: practice
tools.description: List your known skills at a guildmaster, or practice a specific skill.

skill.description: Skill name to practice. Omit to list all.

tools.name: save_character
tools.description: Save your character to disk so progress is not lost on disconnect.

tools.name: send_raw
tools.description: Send an arbitrary command string to the MUD and return the response. Use this as an escape hatch when no structured tool fits, e.g. 'who' or 'help backstab'.

tools.name: poll
tools.description: Collect any unsolicited output that has arrived since the last command — combat rounds, other players talking, weather. Returns an empty string if nothing happened. Call this when idle or waiting for something to occur.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for output before giving up. Default 0 (return immediately).

tools.name: mud_status
tools.description: Report whether the MUD session is currently connected, and to what. Connection is automatic — you do not need to connect or log in yourself.
